benchmark.col_faults: Column header, uppercase small caps, about 6 rem wide. Keep to one short word.
benchmark.col_public: Column header for a public benchmark score, about 3 rem wide. One short word.
benchmark.col_range: Column header: the 95% confidence range of the fault rate. About 6 rem wide.
benchmark.col_rate: Column header: the fault rate. About 7 rem wide.
benchmark.faults: Right-aligned cell, about 6 rem wide: n faults out of total verified actions.
benchmark.no_public: Shown when a model has no public score. A dash; change only if your script uses another placeholder.
benchmark.public_value: A percentage. Adapt the sign position or the percent sign to your language.
benchmark.rate: Fault rate with its 95% range, e.g. 1.2% (0.4–3.1%). Narrow cell, about 7 rem.
chip.tip: Tooltip of the status-bar chip. n = total action types; earned = how many reached T2 or T3. T2/T3 are tier codes: keep them.
common.loading: Loading state while the agent half answers.
emblem.review: Caption under the agent emblem: n action types at T2. Very short.
emblem.tenured: Caption under the agent emblem: n action types at T3. Very short.
help.asks_outside: /new is a Hermes command: keep it unchanged.
help.session_body: "Allow for this session" is Hermes' own approval button: use its label in your language (see GLOSSARY).
help.tiers_climb: {low} and {medium} are whole numbers of verified successes; {sessions} a whole number (2). Keep T2 and T3.
hero.agent: Small uppercase eyebrow above the big agent name: "#AGENT · provider · profile x".
intro.body: T1/T2/T3 are tier codes: keep them as is. {k} is a whole number (1 action in k is spot-checked).
meta.alone: Label: number of actions the agent took without asking.
meta.checked: Label: number of actions the user approved.
model_menu.badge: Small badge in the model menu, e.g. 'T2 earned'. {tier} is a tier code (T2, T3). Very short.
moment.eyebrow_down: Small mono eyebrow above the fault title, uppercase by style. {type} is an action type id.
moment.eyebrow_up: Small numbered mono eyebrow above the band title, uppercase by style. {type} is an action type id.
moment.granted: Big condensed title of the band shown once when a type reaches T3. Two or three words.
moment.probation: Big condensed title shown once when a fault sends a type back to T1. Kind, not a verdict.
moment.review: Big condensed title shown once when a type reaches T2.
palette.open: Command palette entry. Keep the 'Tenure:' prefix (product name).
palette.passport: Command palette entry. Keep the 'Tenure:' prefix (product name).
palette.revoke: Command palette entry. Keep the 'Tenure:' prefix (product name).
passport.card_title: Top line of the passport card, small uppercase mono. Ed25519 is the signature algorithm: keep it.
passport.download: Button. (.json) is the file type: keep it.
passport.ledger_value: n = number of ledger events; head = a hash prefix (do not translate).
passport.more_types: Last line of the passport card when it shows only the first 8 types; the downloaded file holds all of them.
passport.save_image: Button. (.png) is the file type: keep it.
passport.signature: Signature line on the shareable passport card, next to TENURE. Keep 'Hermes Agent' (product name).
preset.value: {preset} is a preset id (balanced, strict…), not translated here. {k}: 1 action in k is spot-checked.
preset.value_pending: Same as preset.value, plus: the new setting applies from the next action.
recent.hours_ago: Relative time, very short (activity list). n = hours.
recent.minutes_ago: Relative time, very short (activity list). n = minutes.
recent.more_files: Appended after a file name: n more files in the same change. Very short.
recent.show_all: Button: show all n rows of the list.
revoke.action: Button and menu item that opens the revoke confirmation (hence the ellipsis).
revoke.desc: Confirmation dialog body. {name} is a model name, rendered in bold.
settings.in_force: Small filled chip on the option currently in force. One or two words.
settings.risk: Accepted share of unchecked errors, as 1 in k. Short.
settings.series: Verified successes in a row a type needs to be tenured, e.g. "52 in a row". Short.
settings.spot_change: Followed by a copyable line "spot_check: 0.1". Keep config.yaml and plugins.entries.tenure.settings unchanged.
settings.spot_value: Spot-check rate, e.g. "1 in 10". Also used as a big title: keep it very short.
start.change_tip: Keep the command hermes tenure start trusted|probation unchanged.
state.aria: Screen-reader label of a state pill: '<pill label>: <explanation>'.
state.fault: Pill label, lowercase, one or two words: the agent has an unresolved fault.
state.provisional: Pill label, lowercase, one or two words: tiers carried over from the previous model.
state.suspended: Pill label, lowercase, one or two words: the session read outside content.
state.trial: Pill label, lowercase, one or two words: the agent is on probation after a fault.
tier.cap: Tooltip of the CAP tier pill: this action type can never act alone.
tier.chip_trusted: Text inside the small tier chip for a type the trusted start covers (where T1/T2/T3 appear). Short uppercase word.
tier.name.cap: Display name next to the CAP code: a capped type always asks. Short.
tier.name.t1: Tier display name shown in condensed capitals next to the T1 code. Tenure vocabulary: the type is on probation (asks first). One or two words.
tier.name.t2: Tier display name next to the T2 code: acts, then tells you. One or two words.
tier.name.t3: Tier display name next to the T3 code: it has tenure, acts on its own. One word if possible.
tier.t1: Tooltip of a tier pill. Keep the code T1.
tier.t2: Tooltip of a tier pill. Keep the code T2.
tier.t3: Tooltip of a tier pill. Keep the code T3.
toast.acted: Notification after an action type acted then told the user. {type} is an action type id (file:write), {name} a model name, n = number of changes.
type.in_a_row: Progress of the current streak: series clean actions out of required.
type.next: Repair / progress line under a type row: n more verified successes in a row before T3 (tenure).
type.stakes_other: Fallback for an unknown stakes level id.
